dialogues.speaker: Little Luo
dialogues.text: One day, when I was in the forest, I met a handsome, dashing adeptus — it was as if he had popped right out of a story book!

dialogues.speaker: Little Luo
dialogues.text: I smiled at him, but he didn't smile back.

dialogues.speaker: Little Luo
dialogues.text: He just returned the doll that the hilichurls stole back to me... Do you think he doesn't like me, by any chance?

response.speaker: Little Luo
response.text: How do I get him to like me? ...Oh, I've never had this problem before...

choices.text: I'd say he actually likes you.

response.speaker: Little Luo
response.text: ...I did think about it as well, does he just not like smiling?

response.speaker: Little Luo
response.text: If I see him again, I'll definitely find a way to make him smile.
